item.title: Canadian police say 10 dead in British Columbia’s Tumbler Ridge shooting
item.description: British Columbia Premier David Eby describes the attack at Tumbler Ridge Secondary School as an 'unimaginable tragedy'.

item.title: ‘Monstrous’: Cyclone Gezani hits Madagascar, with reports of severe damage
item.description: Gezani has hit just 11 days after Cyclone Fytia killed 12 people and displaced 31,000 in northwestern Madagascar.

item.description: Police use force against protesters in Albania's capital, Tirana, amid calls for Prime Minister Edi Rama to step down.

item.description: Shock, heartbreak after mass shooting at Tumbler Ridge Secondary School in remote town near Rocky Mountains.

item.title: Palestinians fear West Bank annexation after Israel approves new rules
item.description: Palestinians alarmed as Israeli land rules ease illegal settlement expansion in the occupied West Bank.

item.title: Young and old struggle to get their studies back on track in Gaza
item.description: Palestinians are working hard to restart their education after Israel's war forced universities and schools to shut.

item.title: Bangladesh election 2026: What happens, when, and what’s at stake?

item.description: The young leader of the protest-born National Citizen Party has teamed up with Jamaat-e-Islami to contest elections.

item.title: West Ham vs Man United ends in draw as Spurs lose to Newcastle
item.description: Carrick's team earn injury-time draw at West Ham, while Spurs lose at home to push manager Thomas Frank closer to exit.
